usage: tr label [-h] {list,show,add,agree} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,show,add,agree}
    list                graded champion/challenger theses without a label
    show                thesis, cited claims and post-trade summary; never a
                        judge verdict
    add                 store a blind label (P1 rubric: met, not met, unknown)
    agree               Cohen's kappa of your latest labels against stored
                        judge verdicts

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
